commits.subject: C4 F1: execute selected moves at full library strength

specification.section: MAIN 15:15 owner: FIX ALL DIAGNOSED PROBLEMS BEFORE TRAINING RESUMES

implementation.conditional_action_mean: frozen MAPPO mean + committed moves.offsets + learned residual(features)
implementation.sampling_forward_scoring_alignment: ProductionLayer._distribution and forward use the same fixed move offset plus additive residual; inherited score and exact joint KL, member_scores, and bank imitation share this mean.
implementation.legacy_checkpoint_compatibility: trigger_gain and its optimizer slot are retained for strict sidecar loading, but are unused by production actuation. No gradient reaches the slot; legacy values and Adam moments cannot scale, reverse or suppress move execution.
implementation.execution_constraints: Existing MoveExecutor ownership, onset/hold/expiry, observable wall release, CAV-only requests, acceleration bounds and safety target clipping remain in the command path.
implementation.arm_A: Exact episode_components passthrough and existing MAPPO PPO path; CPU command/sample equality verified.
implementation.arms_B_R: One shared actuation and residual update implementation; identical restored worker states, CRN and observations yield identical commands, samples and update metrics apart from the arm label.

changed_behavior: ProductionLayer._distribution(features, move_offsets=None): combined correction is residual + features[:, -1]; fixed execution coefficient is 1.
ProductionLayer.forward(context): includes context.move_offsets through the same production correction used in sampling/scoring.
api.public_signatures: Unchanged: build_arm_runtime, collect_update, episode_components, EpisodePolicy, worker_state and restore_worker.
api.receipt_fields: Existing coop_layer.old_residual records the combined committed offset plus learned residual; coop_layer.old_gain is now 1.0 for production samples.
api.new_configuration: None; F1 applies to the explicitly opted-in production B/R backend.

tests.skip_reason: Existing Windows file-symlink privilege check in test_launch_integration_cpu.py:526.
verified: Selected ease_off, wall, gap_open and ramp_assist commands differ from the paired base by exactly moves.offsets within floating-point tolerance, for both B/R and stochastic/deterministic actions.
Fresh zero gain and zero residual still execute full-strength moves; onset, full hold, release and ownership are respected.
Within existing feasibility limits, one-second issued-target differences equal the library offsets using CPU actuator arithmetic.
Learned residual is additive; negative, zero and positive legacy gain values cannot gate it or the move.
Forward/imitation mean, production/member scores and exact KL agree; residual gradients are nonzero while frozen base and legacy gain receive no gradients.
Strict worker/optimizer restoration accepts nonempty legacy gain Adam moments; subsequent PPO leaves the gain and its moments unchanged.
B/R commands, CRN memory, samples and PPO metrics match under identical inputs; A commands and samples are unchanged.
Existing production backend, generic cooperation layer and launch integration regression suites pass.
